# Format (TSV): fluid_id <TAB> r <TAB> g <TAB> b   (the cube texture color,
# 0..255 — the PRE-SHADE surface color: the model's own directional face
# shading applies on top, so rendered_face = color * face_shade * lightmap).
# DERIVATION (measured from run #231's truth crops, scripts/
# measure_fluid_tints.py): the mekanism chemical fluids render through the
# mean 212.4) tinted per chemical by the mod's client code; the truth page
# shots are the only surface that carries the rendered tint. The sampled
# patch mean (the case interior, front face, shade 0.8) divided by 0.8 gives
# the pre-shade color. The colors are the L1-optimal flat approximation of
# the truth's surface (the canvas noise detail is uncorrelated between the
# legs' texture chains — the flat mean minimizes the expected |diff|).
# create/biomesoplenty fluids are NOT here: their jars carry real per-fluid
# their static frame 0 verbatim (the F2vPack scan).
